'''Nopales''' are cooked cactus pads. They heal {{Value|Nopales|heals}} and have no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/nopales.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Cactus cooks into nopales in an [[oven]] in {{Value|Nopales|cook_time|station=Oven}} or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Nopales|cook_time|station=Kindling}}. Picking up cactus unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating nopales takes {{Value|Nopales|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Nopales|heals}}.

Nopales are a renamed green dye, so they can be used wherever green dye is needed, including [[Green Curry Stock|green curry stock]]. A cactus fired in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] gives plain green dye instead.
